Crores, i.e. GST-reportable domestic turnover in the Rs 300–440 Cr band; latest quarter "Sales Qtr Rs.Cr. 104" with "Qtr Sales Var YOY 5%". Company site confirms Indian manufacturing base and domestic customer base: "With over six decades of expertise in manufacturing glassware, we have become the trusted partner of choice for leading pharmaceutical companies in India and beyond." Note: the annual report does not publish a separate India-vs-export revenue split in the free view, so the domestic/export revenue ratio is null.
note: HS mismatch: declared HS 847982 (mixing/kneading machines) does not match observed shipment HS codes 70179090 / 70109000 / 70101000 (glassware, ampoules, vials) and 84211999 (centrifuges). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company retained, actual HS corrected to glassware/ampoules (7010/7017) with centrifuges (8421) as secondary. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only partly right: actual profile is laboratory glassware, pharma primary packaging and lab/process equipment (pharma, chemical, food, research). Role: manufacturer (own plant at H-27 MIDC Ambad, Nashik; also imports raw glass from Jinan Horizon International and Kavalierglass). Export shipments are factual, dated and with B/L numbers — not website claims. Domestic supply confirmed by audited listed-company turnover, not by catalogue. Revenue: Rs 424 Cr FY2026 (standalone, Screener.in); export volume in value terms not public — null.
